_comment: Vendors the item data lists as plain vendors although their goods need a reputation or a currency. Keyed by NPC id. Reputation names are the original game's; check them if Forever renames a faction. battlegroundReputations lists the reputations earned in battlegrounds, for the "no PvP" preset. battlegroundQuests lists quests done inside a battleground, with the reputation of that battleground: their rewards count as PvP and go away with that reputation.
